title: Building the Serum Institute on horse-serum economics
statement: Poonawalla founded the Serum Institute on his family's stud farm, recognizing that horses inoculated for serum could produce vaccines at costs the pharma majors would not attempt.
outcome: Serum became the world's largest vaccine manufacturer by doses, producing more than any competitor at prices that made global immunization affordable.

title: The COVID vaccine scale-up bet
statement: Before efficacy was proven, Poonawalla committed hundreds of millions to build capacity for the AstraZeneca/Oxford and Covovax candidates, gambling that speed would be decisive.
outcome: Serum produced billions of COVID doses for India and COVAX, became the pandemic's largest single vaccine supplier to the developing world, and the bet multiplied the family's wealth several-fold.
